description: Shared base preset for all bright-room repositories

packageRules.description: Raise npm to the same 7-day minimum release age (`config:best-practices` extends `security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm`, which sets npm to 3 days). Narrow `updateTypes` so the exemptions for lock file maintenance, pin and bump are not overridden

customManagers.description: Update any version annotated with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment
matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>[a-z0-9._-]+?) depName=(?<depName>[^\s]+?)(?: packageName=(?<packageName>[^\s]+?))?(?: versioning=(?<versioning>[^\s]+?))?(?: extractVersion=(?<extractVersion>[^\s]+?))?(?: registryUrl=(?<registryUrl>[^\s]+?))?[ \t]*\r?\n[ \t]*(?:ENV +|ARG +|export +)?[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\s*(?::=|\?=|[:=])\s*["']?(?<currentValue>[^\s"']+)["']?
